settings.ggdqOsmJIhH_text: The fight against gingivitis in pets….
settings.gg1olmy5boR_text:
Gingivitis starts when harmful bacteria build up along the gumline. Unlike humans, your dog can’t tell you when they’re in pain – but the infection can silently spread through the bloodstream, damaging vital organs like the heart, liver, and kidneys.

In the worst cases, untreated gingivitis can shorten your dog’s life by 2–4 years.
